Datensatzklasse Record3<A1,A2,A3>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Record3<A1,A2,A3>
Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first value
A2 - the type of the second value
A3 - the type of the third value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Appliable3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>, Copyable<Record3<A1,A2,A3>>, Mappable3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>, Transmogrifyable<Record3<A1,A2,A3>>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Record3.µ>
public record Record3<A1,A2,A3>(A1 value1, A2 value2, A3 value3) extends Record implements Appliable3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>, Mappable3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>, Transmogrifyable<Record3<A1,A2,A3>>, Copyable<Record3<A1,A2,A3>>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher3<Record3.µ, A1, A2, A3>

A record-based, immutable 3-tuple carrying three non-null values. This type provides value accessors, structural updates (with1/with2/with3), mapping utilities (map1/map2/map3/mapAll), applicative application (applyTo), conversions (toTuple), transmogrification and copying.

Semantics:

  • Non-null contract: inputs must not be null, results must not be null.
  • Eager evaluation: mapping and applicative application evaluate immediately.
  • Structural equality: equals/hashCode compare values component-wise.
  • Stable string format: Record3[value1=..., value2=..., value3=...]

Seit:
1.0.0
